## Summary

Addresses all 21 unresolved review threads across the two most-commented PRs opened in the last 5 days: **PR #94** (11 threads — `design.md`) and **PR #105** (10 threads — seam fixture-scenario mocks).

### PR #105 fixes — PromptCompilerSeam + GalleryStoreSeam

- **Fault fixtures exported as `unknown`** — previously double-cast to the valid type (`as unknown as PromptCompilerInput`), which leaked invalid data into type-safe call sites. Now exported as `unknown`; only `validateX()` (which accepts `unknown`) touches them directly at test sites.
- **`compile` mock accepts `_input: PromptCompilerInput`** — the old mock had `compile: async () => ...` (no params), making it diverge from the seam contract and forcing an `as never` cast at the call site. The parameter is now present, matching the contract, and the cast is removed.
- **`listRecent` test verifies ordering** — was only checking `toHaveLength(2)`; now also asserts `records.map(r => r.id).toEqual(['r3', 'r2'])` to prove the most-recently-saved record comes first.
- **Gallery mock header fixed** — comment said "seeded from fixtures" but the mock starts empty and tests call `save()` to seed state. Corrected.
- All 8 contract tests pass (4 per seam).

### PR #94 fixes — design.md

- **File header added** — Purpose / Why / Info flow comment per repo mandate.
- **Colors aligned with implementation** — replaced placeholder palette (`#FF6B35`, `#004E89`) with actual CSS vars: primary `#e8006a` (fuchsia), secondary `#c9a227` (gold), tertiary `#f0c44a` (gold-bright), surface `#100f1c` (dark-surface).
- **Fonts aligned with implementation** — replaced `system-ui` with actual typefaces: Fraunces (display), Bricolage Grotesque (body), Barlow Condensed (labels).
- **`button-tertiary` added to YAML components** — was documented in prose but missing from the machine-readable block.
- **Max-width corrected to 1240px** — matches `+layout.svelte` and `+page.svelte`; was 1200px.
- **Input border-radius consistent at 8px** — Shapes prose said 4px, components said 8px; now 8px everywhere.
- **`borderWidth` and `focusBorderColor` added to `components.input`** — the prose specified a 1px border and primary-color focus state; now reflected in the token block.
- **Overview updated** — removed the "kids and families / childhood wonder" placeholder text; describes the actual app (relationship drama tools for adults).
- **Label/mobile font note clarified** — `label.fontSize: 14px` is for compact UI chrome; a note explicitly states body text should be ≥16px.

## Test plan

- [ ] `npm run test -- src/lib/seams/prompt-compiler-seam/test.ts src/lib/seams/gallery-store-seam/test.ts` — all 8 tests pass ✅
- [ ] `npm run check` — no TypeScript errors
- [ ] Review `design.md` tokens against `src/routes/+layout.svelte` CSS variables
